description: This file contains the implementation of the ECB class, a controller extension for handling currency updates via the European Central Bank exchange rates within the OpenCart system. It defines a 'currency' method that fetches and processes currency exchange rate data from an external XML source.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller extension class for updating currency rates from ECB feed within OpenCart.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches exchange rates from ECB, updates currencies in the database, and clears related cache.
